title: spec: declare the forward target for `POST /api/v1/webhooks/redeliver` — an optional, transport-neutral service member a dispatcher domain can reach (webhooks segment 1 of #22564's stage 2)
body:
Filing gate ③: a segment the maintainer's ruling directs. Filed by the triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`), splitting stage 2 of #22564 (ruling 「A + 扫类」 on #22438, `6079645593` item 2) as #22438 was split (#22575–#22578). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Why

- Stage 1 (`6093135788`, accepted at `6093165613`) measured `plugin-webhooks`' `POST /api/v1/webhooks/redeliver`. On a kernel with no `http.server` (the hosted shape) it answers `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`, because it mounts only on the raw app.
- Neither producer owns a service slot today:
  - `plugin-webhooks` registers only `webhook.autoEnqueuer`;
  - `redeliverHttp` lives undeclared on the messaging service. It has 0 hits in `packages/spec/src` on `origin/main` `d7b26df5`.

## Scope (the #22575 convention)

- Declare one optional, transport-neutral member that redelivers a webhook delivery, on the service contract this segment chooses: a webhooks service contract, or the messaging service's.
- **Choosing the slot is this segment's contract call.** If it cannot choose on the four axes, it returns `needs_decision`.
- `Clause-②: yes`, since it is a new optional member.
- ⛔ No runtime or plugin code here: segments 2 and 3 read this member's shape.

## Done when

- The member and its docblock are on `main`, with a type-level pin.
- Segments 2 and 3 can name it.

`domain:spec` · p2.
